title: MobbyHill
note: Owner pick for this week. MobbyHill is a single file wireframe off road 4x4 game: driver seat camera, phone tilt lean, rollover physics, four landscapes (Mob the mountain, forest, canyon, dunes), two games (Mob the trail, Mob the hill) with a Fuel challenge switch, ghosts, a damage switch, coins, stunts and a store on the main menu. It loads sdk.js from 2026-10-30-orange-scores.vercel.app for leaderboards and the weekly token wallet. That host already allows itch.io and itch.zone origins, and the game keeps working if the script fails to load. Suggested gate: the demo plays Mob the trail on the mountain in full, and buying unlocks the other three landscapes, Mob the hill and Fuel challenge.
